description: Create a read-only review link covering several posts at once — the multi-post counterpart of share_post. Anyone with the link can open it without signing in. Every postId must belong to the organization. Unlike share_post this is never regenerated in place: each call mints a new link and a new token, even for the same posts. Returns { reviewLink, url }. Pro and Business only: on the single-seat Free and Lifetime plans this answers 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with the plan and an upgrade hint. Use this when the user wants one link a client can open to review several posts at once, e.g. a week's worth of scheduled content, instead of sharing each post separately.

name.description: Optional label shown only to your team (e.g. the client's name) — never shown on the public page.

postIds.description: Post IDs to cover, up to 50 per link.

name: create_review_link
title: Create client review link
